scientific_integrity: Single self-contained theorem on third-weight extremizer multiplicities, with explicit finite-field proof and independent exact finite cross-checks; no independently performed audit.
scientific_limitations: Only three-dimensional subcodes of the full code on 2-by-2 matrices are covered.
The direct exhaustive verifier covers fields with 2, 3 and 4 elements; the arbitrary-field assertion rests on the written proof.
Complete manuscripts of the 2015 generalized-weight and 2026 one-codeword-spectrum papers were not accessible, so obscure equality-case counts remain a novelty risk.
title: Optimal three-subcodes of the smallest affine Grassmann code: a binary exception
